  relation "be eligible for a scholarship"
  role subject ?x
  polarity affirmed
  basis implicature

  relation "have at most 2 restante"
  role subject ?x
  polarity affirmed
  basis disambiguation

@q query
  mode count
  select ?x
  where match
    relation "have"
    role subject ?x
    role object ?r
    polarity affirmed
  end
  compare ?r at_most 2
